effect_modifiers.evidence: REML refit test of bbs(lprior, df=4): p=2e-12 at the main winsorization level, largest 9.8e-12 across levels [0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05]; centred effect -4,512 dollars at the 10th percentile of prior_earnings and 9,800 at the 90th

limited_overlap.description: applicants with prior earnings of at least 39,000 dollars: 410 of 1500 program-year applicants, 5 of them enrolled (1.2%). Their effects are extrapolated from enrolled applicants with lower prior earnings.

340 of 4000 test applicants (8.5%) have a training-model enrolment probability below 0.02; 100% of them have prior earnings at or above 39,000 dollars. No training applicant with a comparable profile was enrolled often enough to measure their effect.

warnings: 8.5% of test applicants have a propensity below 0.02
earnings are missing for 14.5% of training applicants; the estimates assume response is unrelated to earnings given enrolment and covariates
effects above the prior-earnings limit rest on very few enrolled applicants
13 test applicants have prior earnings outside the training range
